source.title: Downside risk and the performance of volatility-managed portfolios

exact_source_method.sparse_negative_day_rule: If fewer than three negative daily returns occur in month t, downside volatility is measured using negative daily returns over both month t and month t-1.
exact_source_method.lag_semantics: Month-t managed return uses realized volatility completed in month t-1; no month-t return enters its own scale.
exact_source_method.scale_constant_definition: Choose the scaling constant so the original and volatility-managed return series have the same volatility over the estimation sample.

real_time_evaluation.procedure: At the beginning of each OOS month t, estimate the real-time scaling parameter from the training period ending before t, then construct the managed portfolio for t.

required_yatl_adaptations: Map source monthly/daily calendar to completed UTC crypto calendar observations.
Define one fixed minimum expanding-history requirement using only the already-registered GEN2 Development warmup; do not search alternate warmups.
Define missing-data behavior without interpolation or hidden deletion of bad outcomes.
Retain a total-volatility source-style comparator because downside-vs-total is part of the source hypothesis.
Add opportunity-preservation gates so reduced exposure cannot pass merely by starving the strategy.

prohibited_inference: Do not copy source-reported performance into YATL evidence.
Do not infer a crypto-specific target volatility; this source method does not require one.
Do not add target-volatility, EWMA, downside-threshold, or fixed-weight trial grids.
Do not use HSSE-005 event-level outcomes, Fresh OOS, recent reserve, or P10 to choose adaptation parameters.
Do not claim source replication; any YATL test is an internal adaptation.
